subject.title: feat(memory): add multi-slot memory role architecture

question: Should OpenClaw adopt these five role names, per-agent overrides, and hook/SDK semantics as the permanent public memory-plugin API now, or narrow and stage the contract first?
rationale: The implementation is technically substantial and addresses a real composition gap, but code review cannot decide which role taxonomy and compatibility window OpenClaw should support indefinitely for external plugins and persisted user configuration.

options.title: Sponsor the role-slot contract
options.body: Approve the five-role public API, require conflict resolution and exact-head fresh-install/upgrade proof, then review the final compatibility behavior for landing.

options.title: Narrow the first release
options.body: Land only roles with current end-to-end runtime contracts and defer placeholder or weakly specified roles until their lifecycle APIs are defined.

options.title: Pause for the RFC
options.body: Hold this PR until the related RFC and slot-ownership/provenance proposal settle names, ownership records, and migration policy.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the role-slot contract
recommendation.body: Approve the five-role public API, require conflict resolution and exact-head fresh-install/upgrade proof, then review the final compatibility behavior for landing.

likelyOwner.reason: The unresolved question is permanent product and plugin API direction rather than a mechanical code repair.
